value.rationale: This is an exact permanence law for a natural quantitative Banach-space invariant: arbitrary Banach-valued \(c_0\)-sums reduce exactly to their component constants. It strictly strengthens one-sided direct-sum stability and unifies the known scalar finite \(\ell_\infty\) and \(c_0\) calculations. The simultaneous-slice and tail mechanisms are structurally reusable, so the result is more than a routine scalar recomputation.
